options: quietly, at rest, went on smiling
alternatives.span: But teller and listener only quietly,
alternatives.what_would_settle: House ruling whether adverbial 安らかに should carry {t:rest} token like nominal forms, or stay as plain peacefully.

items.english: It was in a dim light, and, quiet like that light, three people drawing close with heads together, telling a long story. The story seemed to go on and on between them, for so long without ever breaking off. And in that story, all the good and evil of the world, sadness and suffering and anger and anguish and joy, everything seemed to be told. But teller and listener only quietly, at {t:rest}, went on smiling, and they did not move at all. With heads bent and eyes lowered, only a quiet nostalgia and forgiveness seemed to wrap them there. And there too a deep, deep {t:rest} showed over all of them.
notes: Kept three figures unnamed and telling/listening unfixed; verbs left ongoing (telling, go on, went on smiling) with no past-summary completion.
Used quiet / long / smile / nostalgia and forgiveness / rest without variation to hold the chord; deep, deep renders 深いゝ repetition.
Rendered 安らかに as at {t:rest} to keep rest-network visible; alternative would be plain peacefully.

sentences: それは淡暗い光りのなかに、そしてその光りのやうに物静かな三人の人たちが、より合って頭をあつめてながい物語りをしてゐるのだった。
その物語りは、あまりにながく絶えることなく彼等の間につゞけられてゐるやうであった。
そしてその物語りのなかには、すべて世の中の善や悪や、かなしみや苦しみ怒りもなやみも、よろこびもすべてが語られてるやうだった。
けれども話す人も聞く人も、たゞ静かに安らかにじっと微笑をつゞけてゐるばかりであって、彼等は少しも動かなかった。
首をかたむけて眼を伏せながら、そして、そこにはたゞ静かななつかしみと、許しとが彼等をつつんでゐるやうに見えた。
そしてまたそこには深いゝ安らかさが彼等のすべてに表はれてゐるのであった。

options: And at {t:that-day} they were before a {t:rest} like night, forever.
And then they were before an eternal night-like rest.
alternatives.what_would_settle: Editor ruling on how funereal/eschatological {t:that-day} + {t:rest} may sound; this draft leans not at all per reading.

items.english: All the things of the world, a life, will pass. And only on {t:that-day} when it has passed will everything, all things, change into nostalgia and forgiveness. And at {t:that-day} they were before a {t:rest} like night, forever.
notes: Kept gnomic will-pass / will-change and past were before, without turning 其日/其時 into heaven, death, or better days; same spare that-day both times.
Kept order nostalgia and forgiveness; rest kept distinct from peace and not theologised.

sentences: 世の中の總ての事、人生は過去るであらう。
そして過去った其日に初めて總てが、總ての事が懐しみと許しとに変る事だらう。
そして其時彼等は永久に夜の様な安息の前にあるのであった。

items.english: The far picture lay dark and quiet in the bottom of her eyes. And through the bottom of her eyes, far off into the future, with a lonely {t:rest}, that picture could be seen. Young, alone, she gave a lonely secret sigh, and, glancing at the scattered {t:table} and the faces of her husband and child, she stayed silent.
notes: Kept far / quiet / lonely repetition and far-off future unfixed: in her eyes, through her eyes, in the future at once.
Scattered table links back to supper disorder; lonely rest keeps {t:rest} distinct from quiet.

sentences: 遠い絵が暗く静かに、彼女の眼の底に映ってゐた。
また瞳の底を通して遠く未来に、淋しい安らかさを持って、その絵が見えるのであった。
若い彼女は一人で淋しいひそかな溜息をついた、そして、とり散らされたテーブルの上と、夫と子供の顔をちらと見ながら黙ってゐた。

data.say: Vision drafted spare and unfixed, holding far/quiet/smile/nostalgia-forgiveness/rest repetitions and that-day vagueness for check.
